# Thermo Fisher Scientific

> Thermo Fisher Scientific is a comprehensive life science company providing laboratory chemicals, scientific equipment, bioprocessing solutions, antibodies, and digital platforms for research and biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

Thermo Fisher Scientific operates a broad portfolio spanning laboratory supplies, reagents, analytical instruments, and biotech services. The company serves academic research, pharmaceutical development, and industrial applications through brands like Invitrogen and Fisher Chemicals, with specialized offerings in cell therapy, bioprocessing, and digital lab automation.

## Key Topics

- Thermo Fisher Scientific
- Invitrogen
- Antibodies (Primary & Secondary)
- PCR
- Flow Cytometry
- Mass Spectrometry
- Chromatography
- Bioprocessing

- Monoclonal Antibodies

## Core Products & Catalogs

- [Shop All Products](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/order.html): Complete product catalog for laboratory equipment, supplies, and reagents.
- [Lab Chemicals](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/chemicals.html): Lab chemicals portfolio including Fisher Chemicals and Bioreagents.
- [Primary Antibodies](https://www.thermofisher.com/antibody/primary): Primary antibody catalog with 267,271 validated antibodies for research.
- [Secondary Antibodies](https://www.thermofisher.com/antibody/secondary): Secondary antibody catalog with Alexa Fluor conjugates and cross-adsorbed options.

## Industry Solutions

- [Bioprocessing Solutions](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/bioprocessing.html): Bioprocessing solutions for mAbs, vaccines, and biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
- [Biotech Solutions](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/biotech.html): Biotech solutions for drug development, CDMO services, and therapeutics.
- [Industrial and Applied Sciences](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/industrial.html): Industrial solutions for analytical equipment and bioprocessing applications.

## Digital & Informatics Solutions

- [Digital Solutions for Scientific Ecosystems](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/digital-solutions.html): Digital automation, LIMS, and lab informatics platforms for scientific workflows.
